'''Xellwood''' was type of wood, smooth and strong, with a purplish coloration. The table where the [[Unity of Community]]'s [[Unity Council|ruling circle]] sat was fashioned from xellwood.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
